name: Gold EMA Pullback
description: A trend-continuation setup that waits for a pullback and candle confirmation.

image_reader.method: Detect candle-color clusters from common cool/warm MT5 chart palettes and estimate candle highs, lows, and closes in pixel space. Cool hues are assumed bullish and warm hues bearish.

long_setup.pullback: A recent candle low approaches EMA20 within 0.75 ATR(14).
long_setup.confirmation: Latest detected candle is bullish and closes above the previous candle high.
long_setup.stop_loss: Below the pullback swing low. Skip when risk is greater than 1.5 ATR(14).

short_setup.pullback: A recent candle high approaches EMA20 within 0.75 ATR(14).
short_setup.confirmation: Latest detected candle is bearish and closes below the previous candle low.
short_setup.stop_loss: Above the pullback swing high. Skip when risk is greater than 1.5 ATR(14).

components.name: Gold EMA Pullback
components.rules: EMA20/EMA50 direction, pullback to EMA20, and confirming candle break.

components.name: Valid Structure + Supply/Demand

market_structure.uptrend: Higher highs and higher lows. A pullback low becomes valid only after price subsequently breaks the previous swing high.
market_structure.downtrend: Lower lows and lower highs. A pullback high becomes valid only after price subsequently breaks the previous swing low.
market_structure.bias_invalidation: An uptrend bias is invalidated only by a close below the last valid low; a downtrend bias is invalidated only by a close above the last valid high.

components.demand_zone: The full high-low range of the last base candle before a strong upward displacement in an uptrend.
components.supply_zone: The full high-low range of the last base candle before a strong downward displacement in a downtrend.
components.entry: Wait for price to return to the matching zone; require the EMA component's candle confirmation before entry.
components.stop_loss: Beyond the far edge of the supply/demand zone.
components.take_profit: Most recent swing high for longs or swing low for shorts; reject if reward is less than 2.5 times risk.

combination.name: Gold Valid-Structure Zone Pullback
combination.long: EMA trend is bullish AND valid structure is bullish AND price retests demand AND bullish candle confirmation passes.
combination.short: EMA trend is bearish AND valid structure is bearish AND price retests supply AND bearish candle confirmation passes.
combination.conflict: If components disagree, a valid swing is not established, a zone cannot be identified, or the 2.5R filter fails, return WAIT.
combination.waiting_overlay: When direction or zone is uncertain, draw clearly labeled conditional long/short levels from the latest visible swing areas; never present them as active orders.

no_trade_when: Fewer than 12 candle groups are detected.
Candle colors are not distinguishable in the screenshot.
EMA trend, pullback, or confirmation conditions are not met.

references.title: Moving Averages - Simple and Exponential
references.relevance: Moving averages smooth price and define trend direction but lag.

references.title: Average True Range (ATR)
references.relevance: ATR measures volatility and does not indicate price direction.

performance_note: This is a research-informed starter rule, not a historically or forward-tested profitable system.
